integrity: Proof uses the published exact partition-sum identity and supplies an independent strict-valuation comparison. Finite computational checks corroborate but do not replace the proof.
scientific_limitations: The explicit E(c) is an upper bound, not an exact exceptional-count formula. The \(k=0\) term is excluded because S(n,0)=0 has no finite valuation. Priority against unindexed sources and independent validation are not certified.
title: Bounded exceptions in dyadic Stirling valuation formulas
